notes.title: "Gaokao Love 100 Days" 10th Anniversary Short Story Release!
notes.content:
Thank you to all the players who have continuously supported the Class Tangerine.
Our new work, "Bagel Love Story" is now available!

This new release is set in the same universe as "Gaokao Love 100 Days",
 with the timeline placed 10 years after the original story.
The game will feature cameo appearances from characters in "Gaokao Love 100 Days" and even "Bunny e-Shop".

 How many Easter eggs can you find?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2798600/Bagel_Love_Story/

* Currently the game is only available in Chinese, please wishlist it if you're interested.

tags.feature: Our new work, "Bagel Love Story" is now available!

notes.title: [END] Reward Event: Send Out a Switch Console
notes.content:
We just released Gaokao.Love.100Days on Nintendo Switch platform!

To celebrate the milestone and thank all the players who supporting us, we would like to start a special promotion.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8866545/4870217f7de3a0ed6bf9c63590a3b2f703934ce1.jpg[/img]

As long as you:
1. Followed the NVLMaker Steam Dev Profile: https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/nvlmaker 
2. Bought any game published by NVLMaker on Steam (It's OK if you had bought them before today. If you haven't, we are running a special promotion now)
3. Leave a comment under this announcement, and set 'My profile' and 'Game Details' status public visible at the date of draw (found below)

We will randomly pick [b]one player[/b] which met all 3 conditions. We'll send this player [b]a Nintendo Switch console for FREE.[/b]
We will also randomly pick [b]10 players[/b] to send each of them 1 Switch Game Redeem Code for Gaokao.Love.100Days (North America/EU region)

The date of draw is [b]2018-Oct-07, 20:00, UTC+8[/b], the lucky player list will be published later on Steam announcement.

Switch version is 16:9 and includes the Cookie DLC. Switch player could visit https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/gaokaolove100days-switch Or search 'gaokao' in NOA/NOE eshop page.

Terms:
1. The console will be sent by Amazon(US/JP) or Taobao as a gift package.
2. If participant would like to have a Steam code instead of Switch code, let us know after the date of draw (by comment, or email)
3. If the participant cannot receive gift from these online shops, or cannot provide address, or the shipping cost is higher than 50USD, then we consider the participant give up qualification.
4. If we cannot contact participant through Steam message or mail address in 48hours after the date of draw,  then we consider the participant give up qualification.
5. We'll randomly pick another lucky player if the previouly selected one gave up.
6. If any participant bought NVLMaker's game during this event, but got refund later, we'll consider the participant give up all qualifications of NVLMaker's events in future. (Please do not abuse the promotion event :doge:)

Contact us if you have any questions: info@nvlsoft.com

[2018/10/01 Update]
Fixed some UI bug in English and typo.

=====================================================
The activity is end now. There are total 581 participants and we thank you for your participation. We read all the comments no matter how long it is. We'll keep working and develop more wonderful games for you! :omu:

notes.content:

[img]http://i257.photobucket.com/albums/hh217/countd2005/gaokao100/menu.png[/img]

加入了隐藏显示菜单栏的功能

[h1]Bug fix[/h1]
War Within Pilgrimagers can be inherited now (when start a new game after Ending 41 unlocked)

通过结局收集列表获得真·西游杀之后，直接开始新游戏该道具也可以被继承了

notes.title: Revised English Subtitle & "War Within Pilgrimagers"[Update 655423]
notes.content:
[h1]Bug Fix[/h1]

Item "War Within Pilgrimagers" now can be successfully acquired at END 41.

If you have unlocked END 41 before, please check the ending in the end-list and get the item to unlock the achievement.

修复“真·西游杀”无法获得的问题，现在可以在结局41获得此道具。假如之前已经解锁过结局41，请在结局列表里重温，即可获得道具（解锁成就）~

[h1]Revised English Subtitle[/h1]

Many thanks to our proofreaders, a better English version is online now!

英文校正版上线，各位校对君辛苦了！

[h1]Savedata error after update (can be fixed manually)[/h1]

Since there are lots of changes in the English subtitle, part of the save data could become invalid after the new update. (English Language Only).

It will only affect the data saved during events. The data saved at “Night Class Mode” and “Weekend Free Mode” will remain the same. The CGs/Endings/Achievements/Items will also work as usual. 

[b]The save data can be fixed and then be used in the new version after the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/347620/discussions/0/598198173700400399/]following steps[/url].[/b]

We are sorry for the inconvenient. ːmuxinː

少部分英文版的存档可能会在更新之后出现无法正常读取的现象，请按[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/347620/discussions/0/598198173700400399/]此步骤[/url]修复，即可在新版本继续游戏。

notes.title: Free DLC Planning | 免费DLC筹划中
notes.content:
<Gaokao.Love.100Days> has been released for one week. It’s amazing to have so many players! 

[h1]Thank you very much![/h1]

To repay our players, a new line will be added as a free DLC in the coming months. It contains [u]a brand new story of Cokkie[/u], who will become the fourth heroine of <Gaokao.Love.100Days>. 

So that’s the news for today! 

See you next week! ːmuxinː

========

《高考恋爱一百天》发布一周啦~~

我们没想到会收获如此多的好评，感谢大家的支持！！

为了回报各位玩家的厚爱，我们打算在近期发布一份免费的DLC。

这将是为班长大人全新打造的一条路线，接下来的几个月我们会加紧制作，争取早日让大家展开对班长的攻略ːdogeː

本次新闻联播到此结束~
下周再见啦~
